story.text: 성산일출봉 정상에서 내려와 근처 작은 카페에 앉았다. 통유리 창 너머로 펼쳐진 풍경에 나도 모르게 감탄이 터졌다. '대박, 진짜 대박이다.'
story.reading: seong-san-il-chul-bong jeong-sang-e-seo nae-ryeo-wa geun-cheo jag-eun ka-pe-e anj-at-da. tong-yu-ri chang neo-meo-ro pyeol-chyeo-jin pung-gyeong-e na-do mo-reu-ge gam-tan-i teo-jyeot-da. dae-bak, jin-jja dae-bag-i-da.
story.en: We came down from the top of Seongsan Ilchulbong and sat at a small nearby café. At the view spread out beyond the floor-to-ceiling window, an exclamation of amazement burst out of me before I knew it. 'Daebak, this is seriously amazing.'

story.text: 용우가 커피를 홀짝이며 심드렁하게 물었다. '그 대박은 또 뭔 뜻이고. 진짜 큰 거 터졌나.' 놀리는 건지 진심인지 알 수 없는 표정이었다.
story.reading: yong-u-ga keo-pi-reul hol-jjag-i-myeo sim-deu-reong-ha-ge mul-eot-da. geu dae-bag-eun tto mwon tteus-i-go. jin-jja keun geo teo-jyeon-na. nol-li-neun geon-ji jin-sim-in-ji al su eob-neun pyo-jeong-i-eot-da.
story.en: Yongwoo sipped his coffee and asked with an unbothered look, 'What's that daebak thing mean anyway. Did something actually blow up big.' I couldn't tell if he was teasing or serious.

story.text: '그냥 감탄사야, 요즘 다 그렇게 말해.' 설명하는 나를 보며 용우가 팔짱을 끼고 정색했다. '그럼 이것도 아나. 인정.' 한 치의 망설임도 없이 정확한 발음이었다.
story.reading: geu-nyang gam-tan-sa-ya, yo-jeum da geu-reo-ke mal-hae. seol-myeong-ha-neun na-reul bo-myeo yong-u-ga pal-jjang-eul kki-go jeong-saek-haet-da. geu-reom i-geot-do a-na. in-jeong. han chi-ui mang-seol-im-do eob-si jeong-hwak-han bal-eum-i-eot-da.
story.en: 'It's just an exclamation, everyone says it these days.' As I explained, Yongwoo crossed his arms and turned dead serious. 'Then do you know this one too. Injeong.' His pronunciation was flawless, without a hint of hesitation.

story.text: '그걸 어떻게 알아?' 놀란 내 반응에 용우가 어깨를 으쓱했다. '기내에서 요즘 애들 얘기 많이 듣는다. 이 정도는 기본이지.' 은근히 뿌듯한 얼굴이었다.
story.reading: geu-geol eo-tteo-ke a-ra? nol-lan nae ban-eung-e yong-u-ga eo-kkae-reul eu-sseuk-aet-da. gi-nae-e-seo yo-jeum ae-deul i-ya-gi man-i deun-neun-da. i jeong-do-neun gi-bon-i-ji. eun-geun-hi ppu-deut-han eol-gul-i-eot-da.
story.en: 'How do you even know that?' At my surprised reaction, Yongwoo shrugged. 'I hear a lot from the young crew on flights. This much is basic.' There was a quietly proud look on his face.

story.text: 옆 테이블에서 누군가 썰렁한 농담을 던지자 순식간에 분위기가 얼어붙었다. 용우가 낮게 중얼거렸다. '저게 그 갑분싸라는 거가.' 절묘한 타이밍이었다.
story.reading: yeop te-i-beul-e-seo nu-gun-ga sseol-leong-han nong-dam-eul deon-ji-ja sun-sik-gan-e bun-wi-gi-ga eol-eo-buch-eot-da. yong-u-ga nat-ge jung-eol-geo-ryeot-da. jeo-ge geu gap-bun-ssa-ra-neun geo-ga. jeol-myo-han ta-i-ming-i-eot-da.
story.en: Someone at the next table cracked a lame joke, and the mood instantly froze over. Yongwoo muttered under his breath, 'Is that what they call gapbunssa.' His timing was uncanny.

story.text: '너 은근 웃기다, 인정.' 내가 웃으며 손뼉을 치자 용우가 헛기침을 했다. '됐고, 오늘 일정 꿀잼일 테니까 기대해라.'
story.reading: neo eun-geun ut-gi-da, in-jeong. nae-ga us-eu-myeo son-ppyeog-eul chi-ja yong-u-ga heot-gi-chim-eul haet-da. dwaet-go, o-neul il-jeong kkul-jaem-il te-ni-kka gi-dae-hae-ra.
story.en: 'You're kind of funny, I'll give you that.' I laughed and clapped, and Yongwoo cleared his throat. 'Whatever, today's schedule is gonna be a total blast, so look forward to it.'

story.text: 요즘 애들 말은 대충 다 안다며 자신만만해하는 그의 모습에 웃음이 났다. 반박불가, 오늘 하루도 용우 덕분에 웃을 일이 넘쳤다.
story.reading: yo-jeum ae-deul mal-eun dae-chung da an-da-myeo ja-sin-man-man-hae-ha-neun geu-ui mo-seub-e us-eum-i nat-da. ban-bag-bul-ga, o-neul ha-ru-do yong-u deok-bun-e us-eul il-i neom-chyeot-da.
story.en: I couldn't help laughing at how confident he was, claiming he basically knew every trendy phrase these days. Undeniably true — thanks to Yongwoo, today too was full of laughs.

agreed, I admit it (used to affirm something is true/deserved)

words.meaning: a sudden awkward shift in mood (short for '갑자기 분위기 싸해짐')
